notes.title: Optimize and Fix
notes.content:
Optimizations
Save files created before this update will receive a "Compensation Gift Box" at the ruins home

Updated the appearance of the Mysterious Merchant

Adjusted fish selling prices

Time-limited quests now display a countdown

Improved CG of the tavern owner's wine recipe

Improved CG for the rice bowl ending of Liu Cai and her daughter

Reduced the number of bamboo shoots required to buy the Golden Bear Statue

Optimized the sorting logic for auto-pickup items

(Items now stack with existing stacks of the same item first)
Fixes
Liu Cai’s secret ending not appearing in the memory log

Main character waking up after death still holding tools

Cheerful form’s light not turning off during the day

In fullscreen, item bar not adjusting when overlapping with the player character

Paper-type items couldn’t be stacked

Clicking "Chat" repeatedly on the NPC menu may cause the portrait to freeze in zoomed state

notes.title: Optimize and Fix
notes.content:
Optimizations
Shortened trigger time for Fox Spirit healing quest (talk to her and don’t attack—event triggers the next day)

Adjusted selling prices for certain fish

Added description when checking on injured Xuezhu lying in bed

If you kill the Fox Spirit and speak honestly to Xiaopai at Xuezhu’s grave, you’ll receive bonus items

Added dismantling hint when approaching ruins structures
Fixes
Fixed several crash issues

Fixed issue preventing exit from Liucai’s room after midnight

Fixed Xiaopai portrait disappearing when entering the exploded Guanding

Fixed Fox Spirit's suspicious facial expression glitch

Fixed fuel not returning when campfire is dismantled

Fixed plants revived by Spring Water immediately withering

Fixed minimap not showing cracks after triggering Snow Mountain Boss plot

Fixed static noise when opening UI near animals

Restored hand-held item animations after leaving Spring

Fixed no light effect when building a campfire at night

notes.title: Mountain Guardian Beast: Xiaopai
notes.content:
New Features
Xiaopai character

(Appears after completing the Shibo storyline, Xuezhu’s death, and the rooftop explosion)

Introductory CG scenes expanded

Added Bamboo House scene in the bamboo forest

(Appears after completing the Shibo storyline)

Added post-explosion scene on the rooftop

(Can be farmed after re-entering and restoring the area)


Optimizations
Extended healing time after Xuezhu is injured by the fox spirit

Copper coin amount now displays with rolling animation

Sound effect updated for using liquid items

Tutorial content moved to settings interface and now always accessible

Xiayin’s note and pink hair items can now stack

Cutting bamboo now has a chance to drop bamboo shoots

Added water entry and exit sound effects during fishing
Fixes
Player could move freely during minor cutscenes

Liucai could walk off the map during the fishing contest

After removing rocks in the ruins, farming plots were unusable

Screen flickering during transitions between certain cutscenes

Lighting was not darkened properly in the snowy mountain boundary area when raining

Issue where the Luxurious Coin Pouch disappears when grilled over a fire

Issue of missing items in the item compendium
Next Update Preview:
Add: Main character will be bound to a "Golden Finger" system, incorporating talent-based cultivation elements (rich in content, update cycle expected to be long)

notes.title: Fix
notes.content: Optimized resource structure and reduced game package size to fix crashes caused by insufficient runtime memory

notes.title: Love & Romance
notes.content:
New Features
Campfire barbecue function

Iron sickle replaced with large sickle (increased harvest range per swing)

Romance CG scenes added

Coin pouch item (can store copper coins inside)

Blackrock Town fortune teller sells "Rain Summoning Sachet" (can trigger rainy weather)
Optimizations
Tips now appear on the loading screen

Treasure chests placed in the scene can now be recycled

Increased slot count for Elegant Chest and Premium Chest

Removed back-holding animation after fainting

Added new dialogue from Grandpa Niu after fainting
Fixes
After Xiayin disappears, she continues to follow the player, and notes and hair still appear in the house

Overlapping sound effects when picking up items
Next Update Preview:
 New Bamboo Forest Cave character: Xiaopai, expected in early July

notes.title: Desert Fox Spirit
notes.content:
New Features
 Fox spirit character 
(escapes to the desert oasis after battling Xuezhu)

 Death mechanic
 (when a character dies, their items will drop at the location; if not picked up before the next death, some items will disappear)

 Mysterious merchant added
 (appears randomly)

 Memoir system


Optimizations
 Adjusted ore respawn quantity (ensure a minimum number of high-grade ores)

 Iron pickaxes and axes are now sharper and more efficient, requiring fewer swings

 Clicking on house doors with the mouse will auto-enter

 Dropped items will disappear if not picked up within 3 in-game days

 Enemy attacks are paused when the game is paused

 When inventory is full, items can’t be auto-picked; they will be picked up once space is available

 Death results in waking up the next morning

 Map progress does not reset between runs

 Crafting progress does not reset between runs
Fixes
 Wheat, Mind-Control Worm, and Gem Crystal Bug in the encyclopedia

 Issue where the “Life or Death” scene with Xiayin auto-selects an option when choosing "try" or "don’t try"

 Some plants not respawning in certain scenes

 Qiantaishui (Thousand-Year Radish) cannot be consumed with double-click

 Tracking icon appears when Xiayin is present

 Some tools cannot be operated using the spacebar

 Volume settings reset after restarting the game

 Ruins' mining sites prevent planting
Next Update Preview:
 Next week’s update will include romance CG additions and a barbecue feature
Following Update Preview:
 A new character will be added to the Bamboo Forest Cave (time TBD)

notes.title: The Early Access version is now live!
notes.content:
The Early Access version of the game is live! Originally planned for release last autumn, it has been delayed until now due to unforeseen issues faced by the development team. Old players will likely know what happened. As a result, some originally planned content will no longer be available. This might be some of the content you were most looking forward to. We apologize if this disappoints you. The development team is now starting over from scratch, and we hope you continue to support us. We will do our best to improve the game and deliver a better experience. If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to share them in the comments or discussion group!
Here’s a rough overview of the content in the first Early Access version: 

 Farming
 Crafting
 Building
 Collecting
 Fishing
 Mining
 Monster Hunting
 4 Romanceable Characters
